about: Open app cells no observable probe can answer, each reviewed by a second person (docs/data/declared-untestable.ts). Rows are added one reviewed batch at a time; a cell that later gets any probe result stops the build until its row is removed.

rows.reason: Our current capture route attaches to an already running app, so it cannot establish whether this terminal exported TERM_FEATURES into a fresh child for this run.
rows.testableIf: the capture route starts the app with a clean environment and verifies the run's marker in its child.
rows.ruling: @cto 2026-11-18 (message 4a09840f, packet do-20261114T1623/34803-route-untestable-go-1739.md): GO for the current cmux/macOS and Alacritty/macOS TERM_FEATURES cells declared by review under the collector-only route limitation; @cpo/term owns the public wording.

rows.reason: Warp's block layout moves the frame after the probe picks its cells, so the painted result cannot be located
rows.testableIf: the probe finds the frame again after painting, and re-calibrates when the alternate screen opens
rows.ruling: @cto 2026-11-24 (a7a5a28e) GO applying 2026-11-21 rulings (1b4464fd, b8b75cbc, 8cde2b32); #37701/#38274. Hosted macos-measurement run 45526885127 (runId a975f203999d956a66e1cd54eaaf0ecd, Warp v0.2026.11.18.08.17.stable_05): same fixed 0,560 px block-layout paint-witness offset on the 5 SGR rows (the 3 alternate-screen rows measured supported on stable_05 and are no longer declared). Scoped to this version and run; re-tested when the 2.7.5 fix (re-find the frame after paint) lands. Prior stable_01 rows removed because selected-results.ts renders only stable_05 once placed.
